label: D2 after choosing a2, when the policy is not strongly committed to a2 (before late episode)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (never D1/GO), and about 96% of mass is on trials where the agent chose a2 (in_action=2); 92% of mass is when S2 is shown. Within a2 D2 steps it is gated by the model policy logit at that step: active when logit(a1)-logit(a2) > about -4 (i.e. a2 not strongly preferred), silent when the agent is confidently committed to a2. Also fades with episode time: silent after trial ~80, peak in trials 30-60. Magnitude is largest when the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward=0 holds 91% of mass; top activations are a2->S2 common after an unrewarded trial) and on common a2->S2 transitions. All predicate variables are observed (action is known at D2; choice is the model own output). Dev: P 0.56, R 0.87, F1 0.68, mass recall 0.95. Simpler (phase==D2)&(action==2) has mass recall 0.96 but precision 0.14.
